Initial release of btc-signals-pro, offering comprehensive real-time Bitcoin market intelligence.

- Provides access to 50+ institutional-grade data sources, including price, derivatives flow, liquidations, news, and macro events.
- Features AI trade signals for scalp and swing trading with detailed entry, stop-loss, take-profit, and rationale.
- Includes real-time breaking news alerts, live crypto news feed, and an economic calendar.
- Offers historical OHLCV data and signal history for backtesting and analysis.
- Extensive API endpoints and workflow for seamless market analysis and automated trading support.
